# The new-window mark-read assertion describes a foreground tab

The scenario opens and focuses a standalone messageWindow.xhtml through openMessageInNewWindow, then checks message 6's read state. Its final description instead says foreground tab. Use 'message 6 should be read after opening the new message window' so a failure names the tested display. The original message is nonempty and contains should; the issue is the wrong display type. No test ran.

Scope: Message read-state assertion diagnostics.
